    Depth of a nonzero ray morphism #

    BGRS 8.4 defines the depth of a nonzero ray morphism as the maximal length of an irreducible path representing it. This file packages that definition under an existence-and-boundedness class, then derives the class from finiteness and the finite ray-category axioms.
